endpointConnectError: Échec de la connexion au backend. Veuillez vérifier l'URL et vous assurer que le backend est en cours d'exécution.
backgroundImageUrlPlaceholder: Entrez une URL d'image (par ex. un fond d'écran quotidien Bing)
customThemeColorsDesc: Remplacer les jetons de couleur du thème

kernelRollbackConfirm: Restaurer la dernière configuration connue et redémarrer le noyau ?
kernelRecoverConfirm: Réinitialiser la configuration active à une configuration minimale et redémarrer ? Réimportez un profil ensuite.

geoAssetsDescription: Téléchargez les dernières bases de données geoip / geosite / mmdb utilisées pour les règles de routage.

geoUpdateFailed: Échec de la mise à jour des bases GEO
webdavBackupDescription: Sauvegardez vos profils et paramètres du tableau de bord sur un serveur WebDAV et restaurez-les sur un autre appareil.
runtimeConfigDescription: Vue en lecture seule du fichier de configuration réel avec lequel le noyau s'exécute (il contient les external-controller, secret et mixed-port injectés).
runtimeConfigEmpty: Aucune configuration d'exécution disponible pour le moment.
runtimeConfigLoadFailed: Échec du chargement de la configuration d'exécution
healthCheckAllProviders: Vérifier l'état de tous les fournisseurs
providerHealthCheckSuccess: État de tous les fournisseurs vérifié
providerHealthCheckFailed: Échec de la vérification de l'état de certains fournisseurs
reachabilityUnlockLimitation: Il sagit de la joignabilité du proxy (basée sur le test de latence), et non dune détection complète de déblocage régional. Le déblocage au niveau régional nécessite linspection du corps de la réponse, hors de portée ici.
reachabilityHint: Choisissez un nœud ou un groupe, puis lancez le test pour sonder chaque cible à travers lui.
reachabilityAllUnreachable: Toutes les cibles sont injoignables via {node}
profilesMergesHelp: Les superpositions de fusion sont des fragments YAML composés sur le profil de base actif. Activez ceux que vous souhaitez superposer.
profilesMergeNoActiveBase: Activez un profil de base pour appliquer les superpositions de fusion.
profilesMergeUpdateFailed: Échec de la mise à jour de la superposition de fusion
profilesScriptsHelp: Un script reçoit l'objet de configuration et renvoie la configuration modifiée. Les scripts s'exécutent après les fusions lors de la composition. Activez ceux que vous souhaitez appliquer.
profilesScriptsSafety: Sécurité : les scripts s'exécutent avec un accès étendu — n'exécutez que des scripts de confiance. Modifier ou activer un script réactive la base active pour recalculer.
profilesScriptUpdateFailed: Échec de la mise à jour de la transformation par script
proxyConfigEditorHint: Modifiez les proxys locaux et les groupes du profil actif. Les définitions Proxy Provider restent gérées dans l’éditeur de profil complet. L’enregistrement valide toute la configuration et redémarre le noyau une seule fois.
proxyConfigLoadFailed: Échec du chargement de la configuration des proxys

routingEditorConflict: L’abonnement contient des conflits non résolus

routingEditorDiscardConfirm: Ignorer les modifications de configuration non enregistrées ?

routingEditorDeleteBlocked: Cette ressource est encore référencée et ne peut pas être supprimée
routingEditorNameLocked: Le nom d’une ressource existante est verrouillé afin de préserver les références.

routingEditorSelectMember: Sélectionner un proxy ou un groupe
rulesEditorHint: Ajoutez, modifiez, supprimez ou glissez pour réordonner les règles. L'enregistrement redémarre le noyau une fois.
rulesEditorInvalid: Chaque règle nécessite un type, une charge utile et une politique non vides

tunnelsHint: Transférez un écouteur local vers une cible distante via le noyau.
externalControllerManaged: Géré par l'application sur le bureau

usage.tableHint: Sampled attribution for this dimension · TOP 20

hub.managedHint: Once added, Hub manages this instance and collects history continuously, even after you close the browser. To stop, delete the instance; you can keep its history.
hub.instanceHint: Manage Controllers here. Choose an instance to open its XD dashboard; history collection runs on the server.
hub.legacy: Old browser Endpoints and IndexedDB history are not merged or uploaded. Choose whether to keep the old Endpoint list on this browser.
hub.name: Name
hub.keepValue: Leave blank to keep current value
hub.emptyInstances: No instances yet. Add a Mihomo Controller to get started.
hub.historyHint: Observed traffic from server-side SQLite. Browser-local history is kept separate.
hub.sampleHint: Short connections and missed samples reduce attribution.
hub.inconsistent: Attribution exceeds observed total. The difference is unknown; check gaps and sampling boundaries.
hub.coverageHint: Time coverage measures sample intervals, not attribution accuracy. Empty buckets are unknown. Offline, disabled and retained instances remain in the selected scope.
hub.empty: No retained observations in this window.
hub.topHint: Independent dimension totals within the selected window. Cross-dimension drilldown is unavailable.
hub.candidateHint: Recovery candidate bytes are uncertain and excluded from the observed totals and time buckets.
hub.connectionHint: Lifetimes intersecting the window. Lifetime bytes are not window deltas and must not be added to the chart.
hub.connectionLimit: Connection summaries require a window of at most 31 days. Choose a shorter range.
hub.secretHint: This is the Mihomo Controller Secret, separate from your Hub login password. Stored Secrets are never returned to the browser.
hub.urlHint: Use the external-controller address, including http(s) and port. The Hub server must be able to reach it.
hub.enabledHint: Enabled instances can be opened in XD. History collection works while the browser is closed.
hub.disabledHint: Save in advance without a connection test. The dashboard and collection stay disabled until you enable this instance.
hub.created: Added “{name}”. Collection status will update separately.
hub.deletedRetained: Instance deleted. History is retained and its name is available again.
hub.deletedPurged: Instance and its history permanently deleted.
hub.deletePrompt: Delete “{name}”? Dashboard access and collection will stop.
hub.retainHint: Keep observations in Traffic history. The name can be used again; a new instance has its own history.
hub.purgeHint: Permanently remove this instance and all its observations. This cannot be undone.
hub.testSuccess: Connection successful · {version}. Configuration has not been saved.
hub.testFailedUnsaved: Connection test failed. Configuration has not been saved.

errors.network: Could not reach the Hub. Check the connection and refresh the instance list before retrying a change.
errors.conflict: An active instance already uses this name. Choose another name or edit that instance.
errors.invalid: Check the name, Controller URL, port policy and Secret.
errors.notFound: This instance was deleted. Refresh the list.
errors.controller: The Hub could not read the Controller version. Check the address, network, port and Secret.
errors.csrf: Session verification failed. Refresh the page and retry.
errors.rateLimit: Too many changes. Please try again shortly.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.storage: The change could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.request: The request failed. Please try again.
errors.invalidAddress: Enter a valid Controller IP or host and a port between 1 and 65535. Do not include a protocol or path.
errors.refused: The target port refused the connection. Check whether Mihomo is running, the Controller is listening on this address, and the port is exposed.
errors.timeout: The connection timed out. Check the route, Tailscale connectivity and firewall rules.
errors.auth: The Controller rejected authentication. Check its Secret; choose No Secret only when none is configured.
errors.dns: The Controller host could not be resolved. Check its IP or hostname.
errors.tls: The Controller TLS handshake or certificate validation failed.
errors.redirect: The Controller redirected /version. Check whether this is the Controller API port.
errors.response: The service did not return a valid Mihomo version response. Check the Controller port.
errors.httpService: The service returned an unexpected HTTP status. Check whether the port belongs to the Mihomo Controller API.
errors.runtimeInvalid: Provide one complete Mihomo YAML and valid DNS settings. A DNS fragment is not sufficient.
errors.runtimeRequired: Import the full YAML for this Controller first.
errors.runtimeConflict: The saved configuration changed. Refresh and review before saving again.
errors.runtimeSaveFailed: Mihomo accepted the configuration, but Hub could not save it. Check the running state and reimport the effective configuration before retrying.
errors.runtimeUnconfirmed: Mihomo did not confirm the configuration load. Check the configuration, device permissions, and instance logs before retrying.

hub.listRefreshFailed: Instance list refresh failed. Showing the last result; completed changes are preserved.
hub.controllerAddressHint: Enter the Controller IP and port only. New instances use HTTP automatically; port 9090 is the default.

control.session: Your Hub session expired. Sign in again.
control.forbidden: Hub has disabled this operation or rejected the request.
control.unsupported: This Mihomo version does not support this operation.
control.invalid: Mihomo rejected the settings. Check the values and device permissions.
control.rateLimit: Too many changes. Wait before trying again.
control.unconfirmed: The result could not be confirmed. Check the instance and its logs before retrying; the operation may already have taken effect.

dns.note: Import this instance’s complete Mihomo YAML before editing DNS. Import only stores the configuration; applying DNS hot-loads the entire imported configuration, including its proxies, rules, and ports.
dns.runtimeOnly: Hub encrypts the YAML on the server. This does not write device files. Reloading or restarting Mihomo uses the device’s configuration file again. Reimport after external configuration changes.
dns.imported: Full YAML imported; the instance has not been changed.
dns.fileTooLarge: Choose a YAML file no larger than 512 KiB.
dns.fileReadFailed: The YAML file could not be read.
